WITH q AS (
  SELECT f.* FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 13
)
SELECT 'lines' k, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) d, SUM(net_amount) v FROM q
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_receipt_line', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)), 0 FROM q
UNION ALL SELECT 'returns_on_q', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT r.return_line_id), SUM(r.refund_net) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN q USING (sales_line_id)
UNION ALL SELECT 'returns_dup_by_line', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT r.sales_line_id), 0 FROM fact_return_line r JOIN q USING (sales_line_id)
UNION ALL SELECT 'returns_orphan', COUNT(*), 0, SUM(refund_net) FROM fact_return_line r WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id)
UNION ALL SELECT 'refund_gt_sold', COUNT(*), 0, SUM(r.refund_net) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN q USING (sales_line_id) WHERE r.refund_net > q.net_amount + 0.005
UNION ALL SELECT 'staff', COUNT(*), 0, SUM(net_amount) FROM q WHERE staff_purchase_flag
UNION ALL SELECT 'maxloaded', 0, 0, 0 FROM q

calls.statement:
WITH sold_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.sale_date, cp.subcategory, p.subcategory AS subcategory_was, p.category AS category_was, f.net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s     ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p   ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp  ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    JOIN dim_date d      ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND cp.category = 'Garden'
      AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 1 AND 3
),
refunds AS (
    SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT l.subcategory,
       SUM(l.net_amount) AS sold_net,
       COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) AS returned_net,
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) / SUM(l.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct,
       MAX(l.sale_date) + 30 <= (SELECT MAX(calendar_date) FROM dim_date) AS cohort_complete,
       COUNT(*) AS n_lines,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.category_was <> 'Garden' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS was_not_garden
FROM sold_lines l
LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
